query: What is the required action if an accident occurs, regardless of its severity or visible damage?
reference_answer: Report the accident to your insurer within 24 hours or by the next working day with your accident vehicle, even if there is no visible damage or you are not claiming from any insurers or third parties.
answer: In the case of any accident, regardless of severity or visible damage, the immediate action is to ensure safety by stopping the vehicle if possible and activating the emergency brake. Next, call emergency services immediately. [System Knowledge]
